scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplied; finite numeric diagnostics are not used as an all-degree proof. No independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exterior positive real evaluation point; degree n at least 1; disk and n+1-atomic optimal prediction designs only. The known optimal prediction variance and classical Szegő quadrature parametrization are not new. Extreme-mass phase classification and parity criterion are the subject of the claim. The high-degree limit holds for fixed a in (0,1), not uniformly up to the boundary; historical priority remains best-knowledge.
title: Sharp mass balancing of minimal atomic prediction measures on the disk
